remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed CLI version in examples and require user confirmation before downloading or executing package code.

content.user_title: Build Solana Mobile Apps for Android
content.value_statement: Solana Mobile setup often fails because native modules, templates, and Android tooling must align. This skill guides reliable setup, integration, diagnosis, and emulator workflows.
actual_capabilities: Selects maintained Solana Mobile templates for new Expo projects.
Provides commands for scaffolding projects and creating Android development builds.
Guides Solana integration into an existing Expo application.
Checks Android and Node toolchains with the solana-mobile doctor workflow.
Explains emulator creation, startup, status, and wallet testing requirements.
Diagnoses common Gradle, Metro, SDK, device, and native module failures.
limitations: Mobile Wallet Adapter support is limited to Android.
Expo Go cannot load the required native wallet modules.
Emulators require a separate compatible wallet application for wallet flows.
Seeker Genesis Token features require a physical Seeker device.

use_cases.title: Start a Solana Mobile Project
use_cases.description: Choose a maintained template, scaffold the project, and create an Android development build.
use_cases.target_user: Mobile developers starting a new Solana application

use_cases.title: Add Solana to Expo
use_cases.description: Integrate crypto support, wallet providers, cluster configuration, and native dependencies into an existing app.
use_cases.target_user: React Native developers extending an Expo application

use_cases.title: Repair Android Builds
use_cases.description: Diagnose SDK, Gradle, Metro, emulator, and native module problems with focused checks.
use_cases.target_user: Development teams troubleshooting Solana Mobile builds

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Starter Template
prompt_templates.prompt: I am creating a Solana Mobile app named [name]. I need [wallet, styling, or authentication features]. Recommend a template and explain the choice.

prompt_templates.title: Scaffold an Android App
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a setup plan for [app name] using [package manager]. Include the scaffold command, required Android prerequisites, and first development build steps.

prompt_templates.title: Integrate an Existing Expo App
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Expo app structure and plan Solana integration. Use [Solana Kit or web3.js]. Cover dependencies, crypto initialization, providers, configuration, and rebuilding.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a Failed Mobile Build
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose this Solana Mobile failure: [error and context]. Separate environment, Gradle, Metro, emulator, and wallet causes. Propose ordered checks with expected results.

output_examples.input: Recommend a template for a new Android wallet app using current Solana libraries.
output_examples.output: Use the wallet-ready Solana Kit template. It includes Mobile Wallet Adapter and styling, while avoiding a new dependency on legacy web3.js.

output_examples.input: Explain why wallet connection does nothing when the app runs in Expo Go.
output_examples.output: Expo Go lacks the native Android modules required by Mobile Wallet Adapter. Create and install an Android development build, then test with a wallet application.

output_examples.input: Diagnose an Android SDK location error after the environment check passes.
output_examples.output: The checker found the default SDK, but Gradle lacks an exported path. Configure the SDK location, restart the shell, and rebuild.

best_practices: Run the environment doctor before investigating unexplained build failures.
Prefer maintained Solana Kit templates for new applications.
Keep secrets on a backend because public Expo variables are bundled into the application.
anti_patterns: Do not test Mobile Wallet Adapter features in Expo Go.
Do not mix Solana Kit and web3.js without a migration requirement.
Do not place paid RPC keys or other secrets in public Expo variables.

faq.question: Can I use this skill for iOS wallet features?
faq.answer: No. The skill notes that Mobile Wallet Adapter wallet support is available only on Android.

faq.question: Does Mobile Wallet Adapter work in Expo Go?
faq.answer: No. It requires native Android modules, so you must create a development build.

faq.question: Which template should a new project use?
faq.answer: Use a maintained Solana Kit template. The wallet template is the default when connection, signing, and sending are required.

faq.question: Can this skill add Solana to an existing Expo app?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers dependencies, crypto initialization, entry ordering, providers, cluster configuration, rebuilding, and verification.

faq.question: Can an emulator test wallet connections?
faq.answer: Yes, after installing a compatible wallet application. A fresh emulator has no wallet handler.

faq.question: Does the skill implement transactions or smart contracts?
faq.answer: No. It directs wallet transaction work and general Solana program development to related specialized skills.
